newsitem.title: USA: RAYTEL TO RETAIN DIAGNOSTIC IMAGING UNIT.
newsitem.headline: RAYTEL TO RETAIN DIAGNOSTIC IMAGING UNIT.

text.p: Raytel Medical Corp said Tuesday that it decided to retain its diagnostic imaging business following consideration of multiple options.
In May Raytel had stated its intention to explore options for the future of the business.

Following investigation of the alternatives available, the company said it determined that the best strategy "at the current time" is to continue developing the imaging business through some additional investment in the group and expanding the offerings of cardiology-oriented modalities in certain centers.
